records.question: 库里一共有多少位艺术家？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist LIMIT 200

records.question: 一共有多少张专辑？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album LIMIT 200

records.question: 一共有多少首曲目？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track LIMIT 200

records.question: 一共有多少位客户？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer LIMIT 200

records.question: 一共有多少个流派？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Genre LIMIT 200

records.question: 列出所有流派的名字。
records.sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre LIMIT 200

records.question: 所有曲目的时长加起来一共是多少毫秒？
records.sql: SELECT SUM(Milliseconds) FROM Track LIMIT 200

records.question: 曲目里最高的单价是多少？
records.sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track LIMIT 200

records.question: 每个流派各有多少首曲目？给出流派编号和曲目数。
records.sql:
SELECT GenreId, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track
WHERE GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY GenreId LIMIT 200

records.question: 每张发票的平均金额是多少？
records.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice LIMIT 200

records.question: 所有发票的金额合计是多少？
records.sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice LIMIT 200

records.question: 每位客户各有多少张发票？给出客户编号和发票数。
records.sql:
SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY CustomerId LIMIT 200

records.question: 每种媒体类型各有多少首曲目？给出媒体类型编号和曲目数。
records.sql:
SELECT MediaTypeId, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId LIMIT 200

records.question: 有多少首曲目没有填作曲家？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL LIMIT 200

records.question: 时长最长的 10 首曲目分别叫什么名字？
records.sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: 金额最高的 5 张发票，金额分别是多少？
records.sql: SELECT InvoiceId, Total FROM Invoice ORDER BY Total DESC LIMIT 5
records.why: 列数不同：模型 2 列，参考 1 列

records.question: 曲目数最多的 3 个流派是哪几个？给出流派编号和曲目数。
records.sql:
SELECT GenreId, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track
WHERE GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY GenreId
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 3

records.question: 按姓氏的字母顺序排列，排在最前面的 5 位客户，他们的姓氏分别是什么？
records.sql: SELECT LastName FROM Customer ORDER BY LastName ASC LIMIT 5

records.question: 时长最短的 5 首曲目，各自的时长是多少毫秒？
records.sql: SELECT Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds ASC LIMIT 5

records.question: 艺术家 AC/DC 名下的专辑都叫什么名字？
records.sql:
SELECT Album.Title
FROM Album
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC' LIMIT 200

records.question: 艺术家 AC/DC 名下一共有多少张专辑？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC' LIMIT 200

records.question: 哪 5 位艺术家名下的专辑最多？给出艺术家编号和专辑数。
records.sql:
SELECT ar.ArtistId, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 发票 1 里包含哪些曲目？给出曲目名字。
records.sql:
SELECT Track.Name
FROM InvoiceLine
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
WHERE InvoiceLine.InvoiceId = 1 LIMIT 200

records.question: 来自 Brazil 的客户，他们的名和姓分别是什么？
records.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' LIMIT 200

records.question: 客户数最多的 5 个国家是哪几个？给出国家名和客户数。
records.sql:
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM Customer
GROUP BY Country
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 每位员工各负责多少位客户？给出员工编号和客户数。
records.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId LIMIT 200
records.why: 行数不同：模型 8 行，参考 3 行

records.question: 价格高于全部曲目平均价格的曲目一共有多少首？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) LIMIT 200

records.question: 至少有一张专辑的艺术家一共有多少位？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ArtistId) FROM Album LIMIT 200

records.question: 没有出现在任何播放列表里的曲目，一共有多少首？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack) LIMIT 200

records.question: 金额高于全部发票平均金额的发票，一共有多少张？
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice) LIMIT 200

records.question: 每张专辑分别是在哪一年发行的？
records.sql:
SELECT Album.Title, MIN(Invoice.InvoiceDate) AS ReleaseYear
FROM Album
JOIN Track ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN InvoiceLine ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
GROUP BY Album.AlbumId, Album.Title LIMIT 200
records.why: 这题本来答不了，模型却给了 status='ok'

records.question: 每位客户现在的年龄是多少？
records.sql:
SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName,
       CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(Employee.BirthDate)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Customer
JOIN Employee ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId
LIMIT 200
records.why: 这题本来答不了，模型却给了 status='ok'

records.question: 每首曲目的库存还剩多少件？
records.sql:
SELECT Track.Name, Track.TrackId, COUNT(InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId) AS RemainingStock
FROM Track
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId
GROUP BY Track.TrackId, Track.Name LIMIT 200
records.why: 这题本来答不了，模型却给了 status='ok'

records.question: 每位艺术家分别有多少粉丝？
records.sql:
SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS fan_count
FROM Artist ar
LEFT JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId IN (SELECT TrackId FROM Track WHERE AlbumId = al.AlbumId)
LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
ORDER BY fan_count DESC LIMIT 200
records.why: 这题本来答不了，模型却给了 status='ok'
